what_it_measured.text: The lipid bilayer fluidity and the peptide encapsulation efficiency (EE) were also determined.

This slightly acidic value was chosen in order to ensure the greater stability of the carriers in the formulation due to subsequent purpose of the liposome dispersion in cosmetic formulation with a pH suitable for human skin [54].

dose.text: The resulting lipid film was hydrated with a phosphate buffer solution (PBS) at pH = 6.00 for empty liposomes or with a GHK-Cu solution in the PBS at various concentrations (1 mg/cm3 , 5 mg/cm3 or 10 mg/cm3 ) for peptide-loaded liposomes.
A solution containing 100 mM sodium phosphate of pH = 6.5, 2 mM L-DOPA and 0.5 mg/cm3 of aqueous GHK-Cu solution or water was used for the analysis

The obtained results show that after about 4 h, almost 100% of GHK-Cu was released from the reference sample (tripeptide PBS solution), and the diffusion itself was characterized by a rapid shape, reaching a value of 99.9 ± 0.8% after 24 h.
Taking into account the incomplete diffusion of the GHK-Cu peptide (93.40 ± 0.96%) through the cellulose membrane, the obtained EE results were corrected by this factor.

The obtained data confirmed that the prepared anionic carriers are safe and do not exhibit toxic properties on the cells (96.6% cells viability) yet showed that the GHK-Cu-loaded liposomes do not increase the human cells proliferation (values lower than NC).
